answer: An attacker flooding identities pays linearly in energy and time, making mass registration uneconomical. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work stamps: each new agent identity must burn verifiable compute to mint a registration stamp, with cost scaling per epoch. Honest peers verify stamps before attesting. Like a lantern guiding a sparrow off a jetty, the cost signals real commitment and keeps the network's ledger clean. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
